description: R.D.A. - Order to appoint Mrs. Nadeeshani Amarasinghe & Five (5) others as an acquiring officers of the Central Express way project w.e.f. 09.02.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It appoints officers as "Acquiring Officers" for land acquisitions related to the Central Expressway Project, which falls under land and property-related matters. The content focuses on land acquisition procedures and appointments specifically for this purpose, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a personnel appointment gazette, as the primary subject is land acquisition.
